ml_intake_selective_risk.citation: Fast-path records whose class, or gold-labelled subclass, is wrong, over fast-path records.
ml_intake_selective_risk.inclusion: None when no record took the fast path.

ml_intake_selective_risk_upper.citation: Upper end of the Wilson score interval (z = 1.96 by default) of selective_risk; the value a release gate holds under its error budget.
ml_intake_selective_risk_upper.description: Wilson upper bound of the fast-path error rate
ml_intake_selective_risk_upper.inclusion: None when no record took the fast path.

ml_intake_subclass_accuracy.citation: Subclass right only when the class is right and the predicted subclass normalizes (normalize_corpus_subclass, gold class) to the gold one.
ml_intake_subclass_accuracy.inclusion: None when no scored record has a gold subclass.

ml_intake_subclass_ece.citation: Equal-width 10-bin ECE of subclass_confidence against subclass correctness.
ml_intake_subclass_ece.description: Calibration error of the subclass head
ml_intake_subclass_ece.inclusion: None when no subclass-scored record carries a confidence in [0, 1].

ml_intake_subclass_macro_f1.citation: Macro F1 over gold class/subclass pairs, after the same normalization.
ml_intake_subclass_macro_f1.inclusion: None when no scored record has a gold subclass.

model.description: Served model slug (Ollama tag or OpenRouter id)

money_mae_usd.citation: Mean absolute money-field error in USD after one-cent normalize (diagnostics.extraction_diagnostics / field_scoring.parse_money).
money_mae_usd.description: Mean absolute money-field error in USD (run-level diagnostic)
money_mae_usd.inclusion: None when either side is unparseable. Empty GT amounts skipped.
money_mae_usd.notes: Existing diagnostics surface; registered so money-bearing specialist suites can emit it

n_docs.description: Document count for the serving run (identity.n, else n_requests)

n_requests.description: Number of per-request serving observations in the run

output_tokens_per_second.inclusion: None when TTFT missing or e2e ≤ ttft.

parse_error.citation: Not computed in llm-dojo-scoring. Mailroom SCORE_CONFIGS / Langfuse transport alias preserved so consolidation is lossless.
parse_error.description: Output failed to parse (quick health check — promoted per pruning plan)
parse_error.inclusion: Never produced by this package's scorers; value is whatever the pipeline emits. Skip when the emitter omits the key.
parse_error.notes: mailroom SCORE_CONFIGS name preserved; not computed in this package

parse_ok.citation: v0.18 format vs extraction split — parse success without field match.
parse_ok.description: Prediction parsed as JSON / structured output without prose wrapper
parse_ok.inclusion: Emitted alongside schema_valid on every extraction scorecard.

per_field_scores.description: Type-aware per-field scores (date MAE, money error, name fuzzy match)

precision.citation: One-vs-rest / binary precision TP/(TP+FP). van Rijsbergen Fβ (Information Retrieval, 1979); F1 is the harmonic mean (β=1), F2 uses β=2 so 5PR/(4P+R). score_task fills this from classification.macro_prf for multiclass.
precision.inclusion: Computed when expected and predicted label sequences are non-empty. Empty/null labels are dropped. score_task drops ERROR_PREFIX rows. Returns 0.0 with n=0 rather than inventing a score on an empty run.

precision_macro.citation: Unweighted macro-average of one-vs-rest P/R/Fβ over the label set (Sokolova & Lapalme 2009-style). Same Fβ as classification.fbeta.
precision_macro.inclusion: Computed when expected and predicted label sequences are non-empty. Empty/null labels are dropped. score_task drops ERROR_PREFIX rows. Returns 0.0 with n=0 rather than inventing a score on an empty run.

prompt_tokens.citation: Sum of prompt/input tokens over observations (OpenAI usage.prompt_tokens).
prompt_tokens.description: Prompt / input token count for the serving run
prompt_tokens.inclusion: None when no observation recorded prompt tokens.

prompt_tokens_per_second.description: prompt_tokens / ttft — prefill throughput when TTFT is recorded
prompt_tokens_per_second.inclusion: None when TTFT missing or prompt_tokens missing.

quantization.description: Quantization tag (awq, gptq, fp16, q4_k_m, …) registered with the run

queue_time_seconds.citation: Scheduler wait before generation (vLLM waiting_time / queue_time).
queue_time_seconds.description: Scheduler wait before generation starts (vLLM waiting_time / queue_time)
queue_time_seconds.inclusion: None when the engine did not record queue wait.

recall.citation: One-vs-rest / binary recall TP/(TP+FN). van Rijsbergen Fβ (Information Retrieval, 1979); F1 is the harmonic mean (β=1), F2 uses β=2 so 5PR/(4P+R).
recall.inclusion: Computed when expected and predicted label sequences are non-empty. Empty/null labels are dropped. score_task drops ERROR_PREFIX rows. Returns 0.0 with n=0 rather than inventing a score on an empty run.

recall_macro.citation: Unweighted macro-average of one-vs-rest P/R/Fβ over the label set (Sokolova & Lapalme 2009-style). Same Fβ as classification.fbeta.
recall_macro.inclusion: Computed when expected and predicted label sequences are non-empty. Empty/null labels are dropped. score_task drops ERROR_PREFIX rows. Returns 0.0 with n=0 rather than inventing a score on an empty run.

requests_per_second.citation: n_requests / summed e2e window (sequential serving throughput).

review_tray_correction_rate.description: Share of resolved reviews that corrected fields
review_tray_correction_rate.inclusion: None when no parked document is resolved.

review_tray_reject_rate.description: Share of resolved reviews that rejected the document
review_tray_reject_rate.inclusion: None when no parked document is resolved.

review_tray_wasted_review_rate.citation: A review that changed nothing: resolution approve_as_is and empty field_corrections.
review_tray_wasted_review_rate.description: Share of resolved reviews approved as is with no field corrections
review_tray_wasted_review_rate.inclusion: None when no parked document is resolved.

reviewer_accept_rule_violations.citation: Every accept must have text, an eligible reviewer label, no causes, a cutoff, and agreement unless the sorter was below its low band.
reviewer_accept_rule_violations.description: Accepted documents that violate the reviewer accept rule
reviewer_accept_rule_violations.inclusion: Always defined; 0 means every accepted row passed the rule.

reviewer_accepted_accuracy.citation: Correct accepted labels divided by accepted documents with truth.
reviewer_accepted_accuracy.description: Class accuracy among documents the reviewer accepted
reviewer_accepted_accuracy.inclusion: None when no accepted document has truth.

reviewer_class_accuracy.citation: Exact class match over reviewer-answered rows with a verified target.
reviewer_class_accuracy.description: Reviewer class accuracy against verified targets
reviewer_class_accuracy.inclusion: None when no row has both a target and a reviewer label.

reviewer_class_macro_accuracy.citation: Macro accuracy over expected classes with at least one reviewer answer.
reviewer_class_macro_accuracy.description: Unweighted mean of per-class reviewer accuracy
reviewer_class_macro_accuracy.inclusion: None when no class has a scored answer.

reviewer_confidence_brier.citation: Mean squared difference between reviewer confidence and class correctness.
reviewer_confidence_brier.inclusion: None when no answered row carries a valid confidence and target.

reviewer_confidence_ece.citation: Equal-width 10-bin ECE over answered rows with a verified target.
reviewer_confidence_ece.description: Expected calibration error of reviewer confidence
reviewer_confidence_ece.inclusion: None when no answered row carries a valid confidence and target.

reviewer_cost_per_accepted_usd.citation: Measured reviewer cost divided by accepted documents; None unless every row is priced.
reviewer_cost_per_accepted_usd.inclusion: None when any row is unpriced or no document was accepted.

reviewer_routed_to_human_review_rate.citation: Pipeline reviewer routing basis: a human verdict, no usable answer, or a confidence below the class cutoff.
reviewer_routed_to_human_review_rate.description: Share of reviewer-reached documents parked for a person
reviewer_routed_to_human_review_rate.inclusion: None when no document reached the reviewer lane.

reviewer_subclass_accuracy.citation: Exact subclass match over class-correct rows with a scorable target subclass; contract keys use normalize_subtype.
reviewer_subclass_accuracy.description: Subclass accuracy where the reviewer got the class right
reviewer_subclass_accuracy.inclusion: Merger 'other' and blank targets are unscorable and excluded.

reviewer_verdict_accuracy.citation: Expected verdict from the sorter handoff and target: reclassify, correct subclass, or continue.
reviewer_verdict_accuracy.description: Reviewer verdict accuracy against the derivable expected verdict
reviewer_verdict_accuracy.inclusion: None when no row has both a derivable expected verdict and a model verdict.

reviewer_wrong_accept_rate.citation: Accepted = the pipeline routed the document to extraction; wrong = accepted label differs from the verified target.
reviewer_wrong_accept_rate.description: Wrong auto-accepts divided by accepted documents with truth
reviewer_wrong_accept_rate.inclusion: None when no accepted document has truth.

reviewer_wrong_accept_upper_95.description: Exact 95% one-sided upper bound on the wrong-accept rate
reviewer_wrong_accept_upper_95.inclusion: None when no accepted document has truth.

sandbox_cuad_presence_f1.citation: sandbox_scoring benchmark rubric adopted from sandbox 872b081.
sandbox_cuad_presence_f1.description: Category detection within the row-labeled universe; empty universe is unscorable.
sandbox_cuad_presence_f1.inclusion: Category detection within the row-labeled universe; empty universe is unscorable.

sandbox_cuad_presence_precision.citation: sandbox_scoring benchmark rubric adopted from sandbox 872b081.

sandbox_cuad_presence_precision.inclusion: TP/(TP+FP) within row-labeled categories; zero when no detected categories on a labeled row.

sandbox_cuad_presence_recall.citation: sandbox_scoring benchmark rubric adopted from sandbox 872b081.
sandbox_cuad_presence_recall.description: TP/(TP+FN) within row-labeled categories; zero when no positive categories on a labeled row.
sandbox_cuad_presence_recall.inclusion: TP/(TP+FN) within row-labeled categories; zero when no positive categories on a labeled row.

sandbox_maud_accuracy.citation: sandbox_scoring benchmark rubric adopted from sandbox 872b081.
sandbox_maud_accuracy.description: All labeled sandbox MAUD questions; missing answers and conflicts miss; None with no labels.
sandbox_maud_accuracy.inclusion: All labeled sandbox MAUD questions; missing answers and conflicts miss; None with no labels.

sandbox_maud_clean_accuracy.citation: sandbox_scoring benchmark rubric adopted from sandbox 872b081.
sandbox_maud_clean_accuracy.description: Frozen sandbox CLEAN_QUESTIONS subset; None with no supported questions.
sandbox_maud_clean_accuracy.inclusion: Frozen sandbox CLEAN_QUESTIONS subset; None with no supported questions.

sandbox_maud_precision_answered.citation: sandbox_scoring benchmark rubric adopted from sandbox 872b081.
sandbox_maud_precision_answered.description: Sandbox real answers only; placeholders excluded except catalog classes; conflicts count answered and wrong.
sandbox_maud_precision_answered.inclusion: Sandbox real answers only; placeholders excluded except catalog classes; conflicts count answered and wrong.

schema_valid.inclusion: Every specialist score() with structured output; headline dashboards.

subclass_f1_macro.inclusion: Attached by score_task only when subclass kwargs (or per-row subclass labels) are present; otherwise the subclass_* keys are omitted / None.

tpot_seconds.inclusion: None when TTFT missing, completion_tokens ≤ 1, or e2e < ttft.

ttft_p95.inclusion: None when no request has TTFT.

ttft_seconds.citation: Time to first token: t_first_token − t_request_start (vLLM / NVIDIA NIM / OpenAI streaming). serving.score_serving_run.
ttft_seconds.description: Time to first token (streaming first-token timestamp − request start)
ttft_seconds.inclusion: None unless first-token timestamp or explicit ttft_seconds is recorded. Never inferred from e2e / n_tokens.

verified_precision.citation: Precision restricted to doc-verifiable list items (field_scoring.audit_list_field token-coverage check).
verified_precision.inclusion: None when verification is disabled or the row has no audited list fields.

wer.citation: Word error rate: word-level Levenshtein / |reference| (NIST ASR; asr.word_error_rate). May exceed 1.0 when the hypothesis is longer.
wer.description: Word error rate (word-level Levenshtein / |reference|); lower is better
wer.inclusion: Requires a non-empty reference transcript. Empty hypothesis is WER=1.0 when reference is non-empty.
wer.notes: WER may exceed 1.0 when the hypothesis is longer than the reference
